scope: Generic software inventory design review only; no project source, paths, private records or images included.
observations: Publication chronology is not proof of implementation readiness.
A later technique may extend, replace a scoped step, reuse another technique, or remain an alternative.
Partially implemented mechanisms need explicit remaining work, priority and independent acceptance.
Evidence changes should invalidate earlier completion annotations.

checks.name: No promotion of runtime readiness based on age alone
No new implementation acceptance claimed by this design review
